mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points (UNRATE rise > 0.5pp) signals labor market deterioration that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.5pp in 3 months, or Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% over 2 months indicate broad consumer demand contraction that lowers corporate revenue expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >0.5% in 2 months, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), central bank policy shifts increase discount rates and reduce liquidity, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low unemployment rate (UNRATE below 4.0%) reflects a tight labor market that fuels consumer spending and corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp 2-month industrial production decline below 95.0 (INDPRO < 95.0) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) and unemployment rate spikes (UNRATE > 8.0%) indicate stagflationary pressures that compress corporate margins and consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 700 and RSAFS > 410000) reflects stretched valuations and overheated consumer demand, leading to S&P 500 underperformance with negative forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 700 and RSAFS > 410000, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
